info.title: crab-shell-proxy agent
info.description: OpenAI-compatible chat surface for a per-(agent,user) container behind the mycelium gateway. Each mycelium service that proxies crab-shell-proxy exposes these operations as a discoverable tool (mycelium fetches this document from openapiPath). The operations mycelium surfaces are those whose path also matches a registered route for that service.

post.description: Send an OpenAI-compatible chat completion to this agent and receive its reply. The agent's model is pinned server-side. Set stream=true for a Server-Sent Events stream of chat.completion.chunk deltas.

model.description: Optional model id. Ignored for pinned agents (the server-configured model is used).

messages.description: The conversation so far. The last user message is the turn to answer.

stream.description: When true, the reply streams as SSE chat.completion.chunk events.

200.description: The assistant reply: an OpenAI chat.completion object, or (when stream=true) an SSE stream of chat.completion.chunk events terminated by data: [DONE].

get.summary: Whether the caller's instance still needs a restart
get.description: Derived, not stored: the workspace is pending when its last restart predates the newest notice reaching it (its own, or one raised at its agent / subscription / tenant scope). Read access is enough — a read-only member cannot trigger a restart but must still see a scheduled one coming.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: The tenant the caller's workspace belongs to.

parameters.name: subs_acc_id
parameters.description: The subscription account the caller's workspace belongs to.

200.description: pending, reason, note, noticeAt, scheduledAt, lastRestartAt, running, and canRestart — whether THIS caller may act on it. A read-only member sees the notice with canRestart=false; the client cannot infer that, because holding read on an agent says nothing about holding write.

post.description: Restarts only the caller's own container: the workspace is resolved from the mycelium profile and the routed agent, so a user id supplied in the request is ignored, never honoured. Requires WRITE on the agent role — enforced in-proxy, because the gateway matches routes by path alone and cannot gate GET and POST differently. Answers {"status":"noop"} when the container was already stopped: nothing was bounced, but the notice is resolved because the next cold start begins from the new state.

post.summary: Restart a scope now, schedule it, or just notify
post.description: mode is now | notice | schedule. "schedule" requires an RFC3339 "at" in the future and within 7 days; the timer is re-armed from disk when the proxy restarts, and one that came due while it was down fires immediately. Authority over the target follows the same rule as shared content: a subscriptions-manager owns their subscription, a tenant manager the tenant.

400.description: Unknown mode, or an "at" that is absent, past, unparseable or beyond 7 days.

post.description: Sends one minimal completion to POST {api_base}/chat/completions — the same request picoclaw's own client makes. https only, no redirects followed, and the resolved address is refused when it is inside the deployment. The provider's response body is never returned: the answer is {ok, status_code, latency_ms, detail}, where detail is an error class. Rate-limited per account.
